title: Air Force funding of the movie Stargate

tellings.quote: You know, that the Air Force funded that movie Stargate, you know, the Kurt Russell
Do you know the the Air Force funded the movie Stargate where there's like a portal by the pyramid?
tellings.difference: Mentions the portal by the pyramid in the movie.
tellings.link_reason: Jesse Michels again says the Air Force funded the movie Stargate.

plain: The Air Force paid to help make Stargate, the 1994 Kurt Russell film, according to Jesse Michels. He brings it up twice, in two different conversations, without naming a source, and the second time he points out that the movie is about a portal by the pyramids. His point is that the military may have had a hand in shaping the stories the public tells about ancient gateways and other worlds.
